opis.en: The statue of Dušan Košutić comes from the 1954 fallen fighters memorial outside the school in Jasenica; after 1978 it was moved to the school in Suvaja near Bosanska Krupa. Its head and hands are missing, and the former school location remains approximate.

opis.sh: Posvećeno boravku Vrhovnog štaba sa Titom u ovoj pećini početkom 1944. i [nemačkom desantu na Drvar](Q931125) 25. maja 1944, tokom koga se Tito iz nje izvukao.
opis.en: Dedicated to the stay of the Supreme Headquarters with Tito in this cave in early 1944 and to the [German airborne raid on Drvar](Q931125) on 25 May 1944, during which Tito escaped from it.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [bici na Sutjesci](Q1419973) iz maja i juna 1943, u kojoj su partizani u Dolini heroja uz velike gubitke probili nemački obruč. Kompleks je deo Nacionalnog parka Sutjeska.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973) of May and June 1943, in which the Partisans broke through the German encirclement in the Valley of Heroes at great cost. The complex is part of Sutjeska National Park.

opis.sh: Grob [Nurije Pozderca](Q12756368), umrlog od rana u bici na Sutjesci. Prvobitno obeležje postojalo je pre 1975, a kasniju skulpturu izradio je Miodrag Živković 1987. godine.
opis.en: The grave of [Nurija Pozderac](Q12756368), who died of wounds sustained in the Battle of the Sutjeska. An earlier memorial existed before 1975; Miodrag Živković created the later sculpture in 1987.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto gde je Josip Broz Tito ranjen 9. juna 1943. godine tokom [bitke na Sutjesci](Q1419973). Prvobitno obeležje potiče iz 1975, a sadašnje skulpture Miodraga Živkovića postavljene su 1987.
opis.en: Marks the place where Josip Broz Tito was wounded on 9 June 1943 during the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973). The original memorial dates from 1975; the present sculptures by Miodrag Živković were installed in 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Savi Kovačeviću](Q821495), poginulom u bici na Sutjesci. Prvobitno obeležje podignuto je 1951, a Miodrag Živković oblikovao je sadašnju celinu 1987. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Sava Kovačević](Q821495), killed in the Battle of the Sutjeska. The original memorial was erected in 1951; Miodrag Živković designed the present ensemble in 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Drugoj dalmatinskoj brigadi](Q117668). Prvobitno obeležje postojalo je pre 1964, a sadašnja skulptura Miodraga Živkovića postavljena je 1989.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [2nd Dalmatian Brigade](Q117668). An earlier memorial existed before 1964; the present sculpture by Miodrag Živković was installed in 1989.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto partizanske bolnice na Dragoš sedlu; skulpturu je izradio Miodrag Živković 1987. godine.
opis.en: Marks the site of a Partisan hospital at Dragoš sedlo; Miodrag Živković created the sculpture in 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Kragujevačkom bataljonu i borcima Fočanske omladinske čete poginulim na Borovnu u [bici na Sutjesci](Q1419973). Ranije obeležje postojalo je pre 1975, a sadašnju skulpturu izradio je Miodrag Živković 1989. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Kragujevac Battalion and Foča Youth Company fighters killed at Borovno during the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973). An earlier memorial existed before 1975; Miodrag Živković created the present sculpture in 1989.
